source: TrustLensAI_Embodied_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Embodied RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Embodied pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.
